dialect.detail: Micro Focus demonstration program, part of an ATM/banking demo application (BankDemo or similar). Uses DFHCOMMAREA and CICS-style copybooks (CENTRY, CRETURN) but compiled under Micro Focus runtime rather than IBM CICS directly.

purpose.domain_detail: ATM banking demonstration application - retrieves list of enabled accounts for a user
purpose.summary: BCASH01P is a business-logic subprogram in a Micro Focus ATM demo application. It receives a COMMAREA, retrieves account data (account number, description, balance, daily limit, date used, date amount) for up to 5 accounts associated with a user ID, and returns the populated COMMAREA to the caller.

notable_features: Multiple COPY statements for data structures and entry/return boilerplate (CCASHDAT, CCASHD02, CABENDD, CCASHX02, CENTRY, CRETURN)
PERFORM n TIMES loop iterating over 5 accounts
No PROCEDURE DIVISION header detected (likely inside COPY CENTRY)
verdict.notes: The PROCEDURE DIVISION header is absent from the visible source because it is contained within the COPY CENTRY copybook. The mechanical indicator shows divisions_present.procedure=false for this reason. The program_ids array incorrectly includes 'PIC' due to parser confusion with the inline PIC clause on the same line as PROGRAM-ID area. This is a well-structured Micro Focus BankDemo component.
